title: feat(nsparn): parallel-opposite formdraw n(C)!=n(D): reverse UNDEFINED, face UNDEFINED
science: Parallel-opposite x-probes, strictly-earlier kernel, mu*=e_1 with n(C)_1=-1/3 vs n(D)_1=0. Notable defect: this is the ONLY member in the band whose strictly-earlier occupancy adds a tick-0 recorded-peer exception (code: `tick < formation or (formation == 0 and tick == 0)`), which is what makes n(A)!=0 and L(A) defined; #7107, #7120 and #7126 run the same named readout on a tick-0 seed probe without it and get n(A)=0.
